newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar opens virtually flat in steady trade.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar opens virtually flat in steady trade.

text.p: * Canada's dollar opened little changed on Tuesday at C$1.3847 (US$0.721) from Monday's close of C$1.3849 (US$0.7220) in quiet trading, dealers said.
* They said interest to sell the currency continues to put pressure on the Bank of Canada to raise Canadian interest rates for the second time this year.

Dealers said financial markets are focusing on the release today of U.S. employment cost index data for the second quarter. The report is known to be closely watched by U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan, and should offer clues about the next likely move in interest rates.

In Canada, pressure is also continuing to build in the currency markets for a second Bank of Canada rate hike. The central bank last month hiked interest rates for the first time in two years response to prolonged weakness in the currency.
On the crosses, Canada's dollar slid to 1.3229 marks from Monday's close of 1.3293 marks and slipped to 84.91 yen from Monday's 85.00 yen close.
